name: Unsatisfiable formula (all four clauses on a, b)
note: (a ∨ b)(a ∨ ¬b)(¬a ∨ b)(¬a ∨ ¬b) rules out all four assignments of a and b, so no assignment satisfies all five clauses (the best has h = 4). DPLL backtracks out of every branch and reports UNSAT; hill climbing cannot tell this from a local maximum.
